departmentTypeId.description: System-generated unique identifier for the Department Type record.

departmentCode.description: Human-facing Department Code associated with the Department Type. Auto-generated, unique, stored uppercase, and read-only after creation.

departmentType.description: Department Type name, such as Agricultural, Seed Production, Research, Distribution, or Processing.

departmentName.description: Name of the department associated with this Department Type.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the Department Type.
